mission: Harden the autonomous queue with deterministic unit coverage for READY-task selection, completed-task suppression, and the no-ready-task IDLE path.
acceptance: Tests directly cover READY filtering and deterministic priority/task ordering.
Tests directly cover suppression of a task when its completed evidence marker exists.
Tests directly cover the no-ready-task path returning IDLE with exit code 0.
All existing Agent Fabric and autonomous queue tests pass.
No production behavior outside the declared boundary is changed.
disposition: Implementation and deterministic coverage are already present on main; do not dispatch a no-op autonomous task. Fresh autonomous A2/A3 execution remains unproven and is tracked by MH25-QUEUE-002.
